levels.name: Level 1
levels.instruction: Swipe right to reach the matching Nest.

levels.name: Level 2
levels.instruction: Each swipe moves a Plop one tile.

levels.name: Level 3
levels.instruction: Combine swipes to reach the Nest.

levels.name: Level 5
levels.instruction: One swipe moves every awake Plop.

levels.name: Level 6
levels.instruction: A Plop stays asleep in its own Nest.

levels.name: Level 7
levels.instruction: Use a pebble to hold one Plop back.

levels.name: Level 8
levels.instruction: Sleeping Plops can block the way.

levels.name: Level 9
levels.instruction: A Plop can pass through another color's Nest.

levels.name: Level 10
levels.instruction: Try Undo to take back your last move.
